messages:
monitor-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate and grpc stream disconnects observed for inference cluster in us-west-2a starting ~09:12 UTC. Spike correlates with resolver UDP truncation and increased resolver queue length on node-local resolvers.

nate: oncall (pager) here — paging SRE. tagging incident channel. i'm 1st responder.

sasha: i'm in. seeing a lot of short-lived GRPC resets from inference-service pods in us-west-2a. NLB healthchecks from those nodes are flapping.

priya: quick customer impact:
- ~28 tenants with p50 latency up 2-3x
- 5 tenants with >1% 5xx (generation fail)
- brief customer-visible request aborts in the last 8m
we should treat this as P1 for the cluster.

maria: looks like node-local resolver (10.0.2.53) is returning truncated UDP responses causing fallback-to-TCP and huge latency on resolver calls. TCP fallbacks are saturating the resolver proxy and causing connection queueing -> application-level stream drops.

jordan: logs from a node:```
[09:13:41] resolver: received UDP TRUNC (len=512)
[09:13:41] resolver: fallback to TCP -> tcp connect 10.0.2.53:53 delay=310ms
[09:13:42] grpc: stream reset by peer, code=13
```

nate: recommended immediate mitigations (short list):
1) mark us-west-2a as degraded in the global router so new requests prefer other AZs/regions
2) temporarily increase NLB healthcheck timeout and grace for inference target groups in that AZ
3) disable optimistic connection reuse in the inference runtime for backends in that AZ (reduces retries)
4) scale up resolver proxy pods (if autoscaler not reacting)

sasha: i'm starting 1 and 2 now. executing route weight change.

sasha: `curl -XPOST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://orchestrator.internal/v1/routes/adjust` 
payload: `{\"scope\":\"us-west-2a\",\"action\":\"degrade\",\"weight_shift\":-0.9,\"note\":\"resolver-queue-surge\"}`

monitor-bot: deploy-bot: route update accepted, new weight applied for us-west-2a -> 0.05 of traffic (was 1.0).

priya: customers that depend on single-AZ pinned capacity: 2 large tenants still route to us-west-2a. notifying solutions owners to advise temporary read-only or retry window.

maria: scaling resolver proxies:
- `kubectl -n infra scale deployment/node-resolver --replicas=6`
- observed pods scheduled but they are also seeing high TCP connection wait. we may need to increase ephemeral port range on nodes or shift resolver to hostNetwork temporarily.

jordan: quick healthcheck tweak: `aws elbv2 modify-target-group-attributes --target-group-arn arn:... --attributes Key=healthy_threshold_count,Value=3 Key=unhealthy_threshold_count,Value=2 Key=timeout_seconds,Value=10`

sasha: healthcheck change applied. reweighted traffic to 5% for us-west-2a. watching error rate.

nate: notifying customer success for outbound comms. @cust-success-bot — please prepare a short status note: impacted inference calls, mitigation in progress, ask customers to retry or route to multi-az endpoints if possible.

cust-success-bot: Draft status posted to customers affected list. will escalate to enterprise CSMs for the two pinned tenants.

priya: metric update (09:22 UTC): overall 5xx rate in cluster down 40% since reroute, stream reset rate down 55% but p50 still elevated for requests that hit us-west-2a by sticky sessions.

maria: follow-up actions:
- investigate resolver provider (cloud DNS) metrics for the AZ (thundering herd or partial resolver outage)
- run kernel ephemeral port tuning if we confirm TCP ephemeral exhaustion
- ensure canary fallback to eu-west-1 has capacity for sustained traffic if we keep AZ degraded

sasha: handoff: i'm staying on until stabilization. @nate you can go back to sleep after you confirm cust comms done. i'll then coordinate postmortem.

nate: copied. handing off pager to sasha at 09:28 UTC. documented mitigations in the incident board. :white_check_mark:

monitor-bot: alert cleared for excessive 5xxs in us-west-2a at 09:33 UTC (post-mitigation), but follow-up investigation required for resolver truncation root cause.

priya: adding follow-up tickets:
- INC-4832 investigate resolver UDP truncation cause (priority: high)
- INC-4833 add auto-reweight policy when resolver health degrades
- INC-4834 customer comms postmortem + impacted tenant outreach

sasha: closing on-call thread for now — moving to incident channel #inc-4832 for deep-dive. thanks all. :slightly_smiling_face:
